title: Describe expression shapes with match
description: You use tuple patterns to bind fields and recursively describe an expression.

steps.description: You match a num pair to bind n, or a sum triple to bind left and right. The sum description recursively calls describe on both children.
You describe neg through its inner child and give other shapes a fallback string. The exception handler prints an error and returns an empty string.

steps.question: Which pattern handles the outer tuple in the supplied call?
steps.answer: The sum pattern handles it, binding the num tuple as left and the neg tuple as right.

steps.description: You call describe on the nested tuple and print its returned text. The recording describes a sum whose right child is the negation of the number 3.
